insights.name: Insights

about.title: About Insights
about.description:
Insights is a feature that provides you with useful information about your hardware and system. It helps you to understand the current state of your system and make better decisions.
The Insight feature uses approximately 6 MB of storage per month when all power readings are available. 
We recommend that the n-insight feature be enabled unless there are capacity or other issues.

ambientSensor.name: Read room temperature from a SwitchBot Meter
ambientSensor.description: Records room temperature and humidity from a SwitchBot Meter or Meter Plus nearby, so a warmer room can be told apart from worse cooling. Readings are taken over Bluetooth on this machine only — no SwitchBot account, no internet, and no pairing. Leave this off if you do not have one of these meters.
ambientSensor.placement: Place the meter near the PC's air intake, and away from exhaust airflow, direct sunlight, and other heat sources.
ambientSensor.requirements: Needs a working Bluetooth adapter. If this PC has none, or Bluetooth is turned off, no readings arrive and the sensor is shown as unavailable.
ambientSensor.rebind: Readings are recorded from the device you select below, so a recorded history always comes from the same sensor. Selecting a different one starts a separate history rather than continuing the old one.

picker.title: Device to read
picker.needsArchive: Room readings are recorded together with Insights. Start recording Insights above to choose a device.

holdingPeriod.description: Data collected by Insights is kept for the configured retention period. When deletion is enabled, data older than the retention period is removed automatically at startup.

retention.description: Storage health records are stored separately from Insight data. Records older than this period are deleted automatically.
